contract.title: Wave A: rerank-evidence.ts parseValidatedRerankResponse (ValidatedRerankResponseV1)
contract.invariant: rerank-evidence.ts owns ONLY ValidatedRerankResponseV1 parsing (parseValidatedRerankResponse). Incomplete, duplicate, foreign, or non-finite provider responses never parse; only a complete finite permutation parses. D7 consumes A3 output and never overlaps (rerank-evidence.ts is A3-owned per §7.1). Wave A changes no central runtime file.
production_callers: packages/mcp/src/core/search-execution.ts (A3 anchor: rerankResults typed Array<{index:number}> at :566; only .index consumed at :624-625 — raw RerankResult.relevanceScore (packages/core/src/reranker/reranker.ts:1) and derived maxSimScore are discarded today; raw-score retention is B3's Wave B job, not A3's)
test_callers: packages/mcp/src/core/search-execution.exact-pin-rerank.test.ts (existing, verified at base; exercises the rerank path)
interface_changes: packages/mcp/src/core/rerank-evidence.ts (new file; parseValidatedRerankResponse ONLY, producing ValidatedRerankResponseV1 — complete returned candidate order with finite raw scores per §6.3 provider-capture authority)
security_boundaries: Provider responses are untrusted input: reject incomplete, duplicate, foreign (identity-mismatched), or non-finite scores; only a complete finite permutation parses (§7.6 A3 RED row rejects_incomplete_duplicate_foreign_or_non_finite_provider_response)
overlap_with: B3 (Wave B): raw validated response retention uses A3/A12 — retention is B3, parsing is A3; never both

D7 (Wave D): requires A3 (also A4/A5/A12); D7 consumes ValidatedRerankResponseV1 in neural-ranking-evidence.ts/provider-slot-permutation.ts and must never re-parse or overlap rerank-evidence.ts ownership (§7.1, §8.3 'A3 and D7 ownership do not overlap')
contract.instructions: Create packages/mcp/src/core/rerank-evidence.ts (new file) exporting ONLY parseValidatedRerankResponse producing ValidatedRerankResponseV1. §7.5 A3 row: 'parseValidatedRerankResponse only'. §7.6 A3 RED row: test 'rejects_incomplete_duplicate_foreign_or_non_finite_provider_response'; expected failure: malformed provider responses parse successfully; minimal passing: only a complete finite permutation parses as ValidatedRerankResponseV1. Encode the A3-vs-D7 boundary: A3 parses, D7 consumes; rerank-evidence.ts is exclusively A3-owned (§7.1 central-file ownership table). Anchor context: search-execution.ts:566 declares rerankResults as Array<{index:number}> — the raw relevanceScore/maxSimScore discard is the baseline behavior; A3 does NOT change search-execution.ts and does NOT retain raw responses (B3 does, in Wave B). Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A3 row) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-mcp test is repo-verified (packages/mcp/package.json; .github/workflows/ci.yml:150) and must pass.
